name: Refactored Crafting Quality
description:
Rebalance the crafting quality system with normal distribution.

Instead of the original uneven progression, crafting level now has smoother advancement across item qualities. As the skill level improves, the most likely crafted quality gradually shifts upward instead of jumping abruptly between tiers.

Settler with corresponding crafting level 50 has around 95% of producing flawless item.
